activities.name: Balloon rocket races
steps: Thread string through a straw and tie it across the room
Tape an inflated balloon to the straw
Release and measure distance travelled
Discuss: why does air push the balloon forward?
activities.safety: Check for latex allergies before handing out balloons. Keep string away from walkways.
activities.incl: Pair learners so each pair has one person measuring and one releasing; swap roles.

activities.name: Desert water filter
steps: Cut bottles and layer sand and cloth
Pour muddy water through the filter
Compare clarity of before and after
Discuss why filtered water is still not safe to drink
activities.safety: Adults cut the bottles. Filtered water must not be drunk.
activities.incl: Offer a picture card of each layer for learners who prefer visual instructions.

activities.name: Fizzing volcano reaction
steps: Predict what will happen
Add baking soda to the cup
Pour in vinegar and observe
Explain acid-base reactions in simple words
activities.safety: Use eye protection or keep faces back. Wipe spills immediately.
activities.incl: Let learners describe the reaction in any home language first.

activities.name: Shadow sundial
steps: Stand a stick upright in sand on cardboard
Mark the shadow every 10 minutes
Discuss how the sun moves across the sky
activities.safety: Never look directly at the sun.
activities.incl: Learners who cannot go outside can track a torch shadow indoors.

activities.name: Coin boat challenge
steps: Build a small boat from card and tape
Float it and add coins one by one
Compare designs that carried the most
activities.safety: Keep water away from electrical sockets. Small coins are a choking risk for young children.
activities.incl: Mixed groups; each member must add at least one design idea.

activities.name: Mirror light maze
steps: Set up a cardboard maze
Angle mirrors to guide torch light to the exit
Record the angles that worked
activities.safety: Mirror edges can be sharp; tape the edges.
activities.incl: Read angles aloud for learners with low vision.

activities.name: Paper cup telephone
steps: Make a hole in each cup and thread string
Talk through the cups with the string tight
Try with slack string and compare
activities.safety: Pencils used to pierce cups are handled by adults.
activities.incl: Learners with hearing difficulties can feel the vibration by touching the string.

activities.name: Straw bridge build
steps: Plan a bridge spanning 20 cm
Build with straws and tape
Load with coins until it fails
Reflect on strongest shapes
activities.incl: Assign roles: designer, builder, tester, recorder.
